source_derived_finding.smallest_generator: normal no-seed source installation of retained source snapshots
source_derived_finding.mechanism: The maker archives Git files into .child-venv-source-{name}/{agent,runtime}, then, when DEPENDENCY_SEED is empty, runs pip install on those source directories. Setuptools build_meta invokes egg_info in the source working directory during build-requirement discovery; egg_info defaults egg_base to the top of the source tree and creates a <project>.egg-info directory.
not_proved: which candidate source snapshot received the generated directory
the exact generated directory name in the cleaned D131 staging tree
whether a second source-side build artifact was present
source_derived_finding.archive_shape_check: The authenticated Agent and Runtime Git archives contain no directory entry outside the parent set of their committed files; archive extraction alone is not the proved extra-directory generator.
source_derived_finding.inventory_owner: The existing strict expected_dirs/root_inventory guard is the owner of the refusal; no broad allowlist or security/ownership change is proved.

normal_route_comparison.seeded_route_difference: With DEPENDENCY_SEED set, the maker creates .source-inputs/{agent,runtime}.tar and installs those archives instead of the retained source directories; the D131 refusal log has no build-input-directory/build-agent-input/build-runtime-input stages, so the refused request followed the direct source-directory branch.
normal_route_comparison.historical_passing_child: A prior Farm handoff reports an actual normal 9cd3dbe8/1d9ddba5 child and isolated Runtime import PASS, but its retained source tree/path is unavailable here; no actual source-tree equivalence is claimed.
